convention: One conceptual unit of infrastructure: the manuals, being operators manuals for conduct and technical manuals for infrastructure. Every CA on this unit is read from here; the global manifest at ../MANIFEST-advice.json reads this file. CA-043 comes from cockpit.constitution line 105 under CO-087.

units.summary: Manuals gather the commander's records and the pilot's approved submissions into single topics covering infrastructure and conduct. Operators manuals cover conduct and show the pilot and crew how to work the cockpit; technical manuals cover infrastructure and help agents find their way around.
